features.heading: We find the technical reasons your pages aren't ranking — and fix them at the source

items.title: Crawl and indexing diagnosed properly
items.description: We crawl your full site, cross-check it against Google Search Console, and pin down exactly why pages are excluded — blocked by robots.txt, marked noindex, lost to crawl errors, or never discovered — then fix each cause.

items.title: Sitemaps, robots, and canonicals done right
items.description: We build clean XML sitemaps, write a correct robots.txt, set canonical tags to kill duplicate-content confusion, and trim index bloat so Google spends its crawl budget on the pages that actually matter.

items.title: Structured data that earns rich results
items.description: We add valid JSON-LD schema — organisation, breadcrumb, FAQ, product, article, and local business — so your listings qualify for rich snippets and are easier for both Google and AI search to understand.

items.title: Built for bilingual, multi-region sites
items.description: We implement hreflang correctly across your Arabic and English pages and Gulf regional targeting, so the right language and country version shows to the right searcher instead of competing against itself.

faqs.question: Why are my pages not showing up in Google at all?
faqs.answer: Usually it is a technical block rather than a content problem — a stray noindex tag, a robots.txt rule, a broken canonical, or pages Google simply never discovered because nothing links to them. We run a full crawl and compare it against your Search Console coverage report to find the exact cause, then fix it so the pages can be indexed.

faqs.question: What is the difference between technical SEO and on-page SEO?
faqs.answer: On-page SEO is about the content of a page — its titles, headings, keywords, and copy. Technical SEO is about whether search engines can crawl, render, and index that page in the first place, and how your site is structured underneath. Both matter, and we are happy to handle the technical foundation while your content work continues in parallel.

faqs.question: Will I be able to see what you fixed and the results?
faqs.answer: Yes. We start with a written technical audit listing every issue we found, and we work inside your own Google Search Console so you can watch indexing and crawl errors improve over time. You get a clear before-and-after, not vague assurances, and everything we configure stays in your accounts.

faqs.question: Do you handle technical SEO for Arabic and bilingual websites?
faqs.answer: Yes — it is one of the things we are most careful about. We set up hreflang tags so Google serves the correct Arabic or English version to each searcher, handle right-to-left and regional Gulf targeting, and make sure your two language versions support each other instead of competing. We deliver in both Arabic and English.

faqs.question: Do I need a brand-new website to fix the technical SEO?
faqs.answer: Almost never. Most technical issues — crawl errors, broken sitemaps, missing schema, slow rendering, messy redirects — are fixed on your existing site without a rebuild. If your platform is genuinely the bottleneck we will say so plainly in the free consultation rather than pushing work you do not need. The quickest way to start is a message on WhatsApp.
